description:
Arkcon welcomes you to our newly constructed two bedroom home to let on the ever popular Leinster Street East, North Strand. Please email your enquiry. Phone call enquiries are not accepted due to high volume demand. We aim to respond to all enquiries, however this may not be possible. Thank you for your understanding.

Letting experts Arkcon are thrilled to present this stunning, newly built A1 rated two bedroom home, ideally situated on Leinster Street East, North Strand, Dublin 3. This is a rare opportunity to be the first occupant of an exceptional, energy efficient home, finished to the highest standard throughout. Upon entry, you are welcomed into a bright and generously proportioned living room, separate from the kitchen and dining area, with large windows allowing an abundance of natural light to flood the space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is fitted with modern appliances including a four ring hob, oven, grill and more, with ample worktop and storage space throughout. The first bedroom is a well-appointed double room benefitting from its own private ensuite, while the second bedroom is generously sized and fitted with two single beds and ample storage space. Bed changes are available upon request. The main bathroom is gleaming and benefits from an electric shower providing instant hot water. The property benefits from heat pump heating throughout, ensuring exceptional energy efficiency and low running costs all year round. On-street parking is available in the surrounding area.

Leinster Street East is quietly nestled in North Strand, a well-established and conveniently located neighbourhood on the northside of Dublin city. The area is within easy reach of Fairview, Clontarf, Phibsborough and Dublin city centre, placing residents within comfortable distance of an outstanding variety of cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, shopping centres and public parks. Fairview Park is within easy walking distance, offering a much-loved green space ideal for walking and outdoor recreation. The coastline and promenade at Clontarf Road are also readily accessible, providing scenic walks stretching towards Dollymount and Bull Island. The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with numerous bus routes and the Luas Cross City line all within easy reach, ensuring swift and frequent connectivity across the city and beyond.

Please email your enquiry to make this property your own. References and documents are required by all applicants. Available early September. Bills are not included in the monthly rent. 

Thank you.
